summary: Session 10 of 11 (packaging-and-template-readiness): Playwright E2E Tests For Packaging And Template Features. Delivered: TemplateSmokePlaywrightTests.cs (3 SkippableFact tests verifying template app runtime integrity — login page renders, auth redirect, static asset delivery; skips when PLAYWRIGHT_TEMPLATE_APP_URL not set). Added Xunit.SkippableFact to AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright.csproj. Build green, 913 non-Playwright tests pass, 5 skip (expected). GPT-5.4 cross-provider verification: VERIFIED Round 4 (Rounds 1-3 fixed exception-filter edge cases in skip logic).
scope_deviations: Sessions 7-9 introduced no new browser UI in the AcmeCoffeeOnline demo app. The packaging/template work is tooling-level (NuGet packages, VS templates, dotnet tool). Playwright test scope is the template app's runtime integrity, not new demo-app UI flows.

Wrote SkippableFact tests rather than always-run tests — the template app requires SQL Server (LocalDB) + DevIdp + separate process to run. SkippableFact matches the PackagingSmokeTests pattern for infrastructure-dependent tests.

4 verification rounds (policy max 2 + operator-authorized extension per feedback_verifier_spiral_doc_sessions). All findings were Minor exception-filter edge cases; each round improved the skip-vs-fail boundary.
